tool.name: ampvis2 octave plot
tool.description: Generates an octave plot to assess alpha diversity using ampvis2
tool.help:
# Ampvis2 Octave Plot
Generates an octave plot to assess alpha diversity. An octave plot is a histogram of the number of taxa observed by bins of read counts, where the bin ranges increase exponentially.
## Details
The n-th bin in the histogram has the range ``r(n)=2n...2n+1-1``. The height of the bars reflects the number of unique taxa with read counts in each bin. A full symmetrical bell-shaped distribution with the left part far from the y-axis is ideal. A high amount of OTUs with low read counts indicates noise, chimeras, and cross-talk.
## Input
- Ampvis2 RDS dataset from previous steps - Metadata list for sample selection
## Output
Octave plot in PDF or PNG format.
